mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 58 degrees at Fireman's Park.

The city has two important reminders. First, Pellitteri Waste Systems handles all curbside recycling and refuse, so check their app for schedules. Second, the Verona Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

There is plenty to do in our area today, including the Dane County Farmer's Market in Madison and live music performances happening throughout the day at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a notable incident on October 22, a two-vehicle crash occurred on CTH PB at American Way, resulting in minor injuries and a citation for the driver who failed to yield from a stop sign.
It is a perfect day for a treat, and Culver's is currently serving their delicious Mint Explosion. Stop by anytime before they close at 10:30 PM.
